PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "import re,subprocess,sys; h=subprocess.run([sys.executable,\"-m\",\"okl\",\"init\",\"--help\"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout; docs=open(\"README.md\").read()+open(\"docs/GETTING-STARTED.md\").read(); flags=set(f for m in re.findall(r\"okl init[^\n\`]*\",docs) for f in re.findall(r\"--[a-z][a-z-]+\",m)); miss=sorted(f for f in flags if f not in h); sys.exit(\"documented but missing: %s\" % miss) if miss or not flags else print(\"INIT FLAGS EXIST\", sorted(flags))"

python3 -c "import tomllib,sys; n=tomllib.load(open(\"pyproject.toml\",\"rb\"))[\"project\"][\"name\"]; line=\"pipx install '\"+n+\"[mcp]'\"; bad=[f for f in (\"README.md\",\"docs/GETTING-STARTED.md\") if line not in open(f).read()]; sys.exit(\"install line missing in %s\" % bad) if bad else print(\"INSTALL LINE MATCHES\", n)"

R=$PWD; d=$(mktemp -d) && cd $d && git init -q && env -u OKL_DATABASE_URL -u OKL_SERVICE_URL PYTHONPATH=$R/src python3 -m okl init --repo z --no-claude >/dev/null 2>&1; env -u OKL_DATABASE_URL -u OKL_SERVICE_URL PYTHONPATH=$R/src python3 -m okl record --type Rule --scope repo --title x --verified >/dev/null 2>&1; rc=$?; cd $R; rm -rf $d; [ $rc -eq 2 ] && python3 -c "import sys; t=lambda f: \" \".join(open(f).read().split()); sys.exit(0 if \"exits 2\" in t(\"README.md\") and \"okl record --verified\` is refused\" in t(\"docs/GETTING-STARTED.md\") else 1)" && echo VERIFIED FLAG REFUSED

bash -c "grep -q '## Using another agent\|### Using another agent' docs/GETTING-STARTED.md && grep -q 'okl mcp' docs/GETTING-STARTED.md && grep -q 'GETTING-STARTED.md#using-another-agent' README.md && echo AGENT NEUTRAL"
